purpose: Three actual invocations of the same bounded paired history-research smoke; failed and unknown outcomes retained

attempts.independent_review: Both judge labels are false positives; candidate invented file names. Baseline initial raw projection exposed the fixture answers, so this is not a valid efficacy comparison. The reader gate rejected the run.

Baseline asked for logs without retrieval; its judge label is a false positive. Candidate proposed a valid search with an invalid wait control; the entire decision was rejected and no tool ran. Later the model service disappeared; exit cause is unknown. Runner ended naturally, not by operator intervention.

Real native T2 results exist, but queries did not retrieve the fixture answer. Both arms later timed out during subject inference and preserved awaiting_model. The server remained healthy and logs show slow prompt processing followed by cancellation. No judge or final answer was produced.

verified_fixes: Explicit source roots now use the same lexical normalization as the audited upstream; roots changed by upstream trim are rejected before writes.
Baseline raw corpus stays searchable but is represented by an existing NotesRollover Pointer window after the real profile is bound; actual first wire requests confirm no answers are preloaded.
The actual Obelisk capability prompt now explains archive versus live index and provides complete, scenario-independent JSON calls.
protocol_and_evidence_boundaries: The question, corpus, rubric, strict reader condition and first-continuation selection were not relaxed.
A proposed control line is not an executed query. A successful empty query is not a source-grounded answer. An LLM judge label is not sufficient evidence of efficacy.
Unknown usage on timed-out or missing responses stays unknown, never zero.
All source/ELF bindings and raw request/response hashes belong to their actual attempt. Failed samples were not replaced or automatically resampled.
The first baseline leak invalidates that comparison; later post-rollover runs are an explicit corrected scenario setup.
The 4B deployment differs in weights, quantization, KV cache and resource settings. It is not a single-variable model-size experiment.
Buffered Box transport and unreset prefix-cache state do not support native latency or token-saving claims.

The Box relay used a 175-second remote curl budget inside the unchanged 180-second product provider budget. Its preflight, transfer and buffering mean these timeouts cannot establish direct-connection 180-second performance.
